title: Chromatic Spaces
statement: Framed prints of interior worlds built from color. Pieces are named by a fingerprint: the first six hex characters of the SHA-256 of the source file.

title: Lone Journey
statement: A lone astronaut outdoors: deserts, beaches, coastlines, landmarks. If the astronaut is outside, it belongs here.

title: Anonstronauts
statement: Astronauts inside colorful rooms. Anonymous by design: identity through a fingerprint, not a face.
There are 1,440 minutes in a day. One picture for every minute of the day, a reminder to slow down and be present. Each piece is titled by its minute.

title: How print sizes and prices relate
body: Sample policy. Price depends on the print size, not on the collection. A price always belongs to one specific size. Never quote the price of one size for another size. When a buyer asks about a size that is not listed for a piece, say it is not offered and offer the sizes that are.

title: Pickup and shipping
body: Sample policy. Local pickup is the default. Shipping terms are set per sale by the artist; the agent must not promise shipping times or costs.

title: Caring for a framed print
body: Sample guidance. Keep framed prints out of direct sunlight and away from humid rooms. Dust the glass with a dry microfiber cloth.

title: Lone Journey vs Anonstronauts
body: Sample guidance. The indoor and outdoor test decides the astronaut collections. Astronaut outdoors means Lone Journey. Astronaut inside a colorful room means Anonstronauts. Never describe a piece with the other collection's name.
